response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize and return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a custom view every time you open a project, you can now save it once and jump back with a single click. This feature is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away at no extra cost. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from sprint boards and overdue tasks to client-specific dashboards and personal priority lists. Views can be shared with a team, making it easy to align on a common way of tracking work, onboard new teammates faster, and keep everyone looking at the same data the same way. Whether you manage a small team or a large organization, Saved Views helps cut down repetitive setup and keeps your workflow consistent across projects. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
